login.title: Sign in to the merchant dashboard
login.hint: 5 wrong attempts will lock sign-in for 15 minutes.
login.firstTime: First time? Open the link in your welcome email to set a password.

setup.title: Set up your account
setup.body: Welcome to Quick Come. Set a password (at least 12 characters), then bind an authenticator app.
setup.qr: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Microsoft Authenticator), then enter the 6-digit code.
setup.errPw: Passwords must match and be at least 12 characters.

common.truncated: Only the latest {n} records are shown. Use Export CSV for the full history.
common.exported: Prototype: the CSV file would download here.

overview.title: Overview
overview.balanceNote: Your balance is the amount recorded for you in the ledger, net of fees. It does not depend on when funds are consolidated on-chain.
overview.unmatchedSub: {n} deposits not linked to an order

orders.title: Orders

create.title: New order
create.merchantNoHint: Must be unique. Used to match callbacks to your system.
create.errMerchantNo: Enter an order number (letters, digits, - and _).
create.errAmount: Enter an amount greater than 0 with at most 6 decimals.
create.customerHint: Your own ID for this customer (user ID or email). New IDs create a new customer with a permanent address.
create.matchedNow: Matched automatically to earlier deposits from this customer.

detail.title: Order {id}
detail.addressNote: This is the permanent address of customer {c}. Every payment to it belongs to this customer.
detail.done: Updated. An order callback has been sent.

orders.settings: Matching: complete at {low}%–{high}% of the order amount, above {high}% = overpaid · orders expire after {ttl} min · deposits up to {lookback} h before an order can match it. Set by the platform.
orders.modeOff: Order mode is off for your account. All deposits are recorded by customer. Contact us to turn on order mode.

tx.title: Transactions
tx.ledgerNote: The ledger is append-only: every balance change is a new line and nothing is ever edited.

wd.title: Withdrawals
wd.note: Manual review: working hours are 8:00–23:00 (UTC+8). Requests submitted during working hours are processed within 1 hour; requests outside working hours are processed at the start of the next working period.
wd.noWallet: No registered wallet. Contact us to register one.
wd.cancelConfirm: Cancel this withdrawal? The frozen amount returns to your available balance.
wd.errInsufficient: Insufficient balance: amount + fee exceeds your available balance.
wd.errAddress: Enter a valid TRON address (starts with T, 34 characters).
wd.errAmount: Enter an amount greater than 0 with at most 6 decimals.
wd.submitted: Submitted. {amount} USDT is frozen until the request is processed.
wd.customerHint: For payouts to your customer: links this payout to the customer for statistics.

api.title: API settings
api.secretHidden: Shown only once when generated. We cannot show it again.
api.regenConfirm: Generate a new Secret? The old one stops working immediately; update your system first.
api.regenDone: New Secret (copy it now — it will not be shown again):
api.callbackHint: HTTPS only. We sign every callback; reply with HTTP 2xx. Failed callbacks retry after 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h, 12 h and 24 h.
api.ipHint: One IPv4 or IPv6 address per line. API withdrawals are only accepted from these addresses.
api.ipWarn: No IP whitelist: API withdrawals are disabled for your account. Orders, addresses and queries still work.
api.errIp: Line {n} is not a valid IP address.
api.testSent: Test callback sent. See Callbacks for the result.
api.sandboxBody: Use the separate sandbox key on the staging environment (TRON Nile testnet, test tokens only).

pay.warn: Send only USDT on the TRON network (TRC20), and send the exact amount shown. Other tokens or networks cannot be recovered.
pay.doneBody: {amount} USDT received. You can close this page.
pay.partialBody: Received {got} of {amount} USDT. Please contact the merchant about the remaining amount.
pay.overpaidBody: Received {got} USDT, more than the {amount} USDT requested. Please contact the merchant about the difference.
pay.expiredBody: Do not send funds to this address for this order. Ask the merchant for a new payment link.
pay.notFound: Payment request not found. Check the link or ask the merchant for a new one.
pay.partialOpen: Received {got} USDT. Please pay the remaining {left} USDT.
pay.partialExpiredBody: Received {got} of {amount} USDT before expiry. Please contact the merchant.

customers.title: Customers
customers.body: Each customer has one permanent address. Every payment to it belongs to that customer; your balance is not split by customer.

create.title: New customer
create.idHint: Cannot be changed later. Letters, digits, _ - . @ (1–128).
create.name: Name
create.created: Customer created with a permanent address.

detail.exported: Prototype: the customer statement would download here.

errors.locked: Too many wrong attempts. Sign-in is locked for 15 minutes.
errors.bad_code: The authenticator code is wrong or already used. Wait for the next code.
errors.insufficient_balance: Insufficient balance: amount + fee exceeds your available balance.
errors.order_mode_disabled: Order mode is not enabled for your account.
errors.invalid_setup_link: This set-up link is invalid or has expired. Ask us to send a new one.
errors.weak_password: Password must be at least 12 characters.
errors.cannot_match: This deposit cannot be matched to this order.
errors.not_matched: This deposit is not matched to this order.
errors.address_not_registered: This address is not one of your registered wallets.
errors.not_configured: The service is not configured yet.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

picker.placeholder: Search by customer ID, name or email, or type a new ID
picker.none: No matching customer. Type a new ID to create one.
picker.empty: No customers yet. Type an ID to create one.
picker.existing: Existing customer: name and email filled in. Edit them on the Customers page.
picker.isNew: New customer: it will be created with a permanent address when you submit.

login.title: 登录商户后台
login.hint: 连续输错 5 次将锁定 15 分钟。
login.err: 邮箱、密码或动态码不正确。
login.firstTime: 第一次使用？请打开欢迎邮件里的链接设置密码。

setup.title: 设置账号
setup.body: 欢迎使用 Quick Come。请先设置登录密码（至少 12 位），再绑定手机验证器。
setup.qr: 用手机上的验证器 App（例如 Google Authenticator、1Password、Microsoft Authenticator）扫描二维码，然后输入 App 显示的 6 位动态码。
setup.errPw: 两次输入的密码要一致，并且至少 12 位。

common.truncated: 只显示最近 {n} 条，完整记录请用“导出 CSV”。
common.exported: 原型：正式版会在这里下载 CSV 文件。

overview.title: 概览
overview.balanceNote: 余额是账本上记给你的金额（已扣除手续费），和链上资金什么时候归集无关。

orders.title: 订单

create.title: 创建订单
create.merchantNoHint: 不能重复，用来把回调和你系统里的订单对上。
create.errMerchantNo: 请输入订单号（字母、数字、- 和 _）。
create.errDup: 这个商户订单号已经存在。
create.errAmount: 请输入大于 0 的金额，最多 6 位小数。
create.customerHint: 你给这个客户的标识（用户编号或邮箱）。新的标识会自动创建客户，并分配一个永久地址。
create.errCustomer: 请输入 1 到 128 位：字母、数字、_ - . @
create.matchedNow: 已自动匹配到这个客户之前的到账。

detail.title: 订单 {id}
detail.addressNote: 这是客户 {c} 的永久地址，转到这个地址的钱都记到这个客户名下。
detail.unmatchedTitle: 这个客户未匹配的到账
detail.done: 已更新，并发送订单匹配通知。

orders.settings: 匹配规则：累计达到订单金额的 {low}% 到 {high}% 为已完成，超过 {high}% 为超额付款；订单 {ttl} 分钟后过期；订单创建前 {lookback} 小时内的未匹配到账可以匹配。以上由平台设置。
orders.modeOff: 你的账户没有开启订单模式，到账只按客户记录。需要订单功能请联系我们开通。

tx.title: 交易
tx.ledgerNote: 账本只追加：每一次余额变动都是新的一行，任何记录都不会被修改。

wd.title: 提币
wd.note: 人工审核：工作时间为东八区 8:00–23:00，工作时间内提交的提币申请 1 小时内处理；非工作时间提交的，顺延到下一个工作时间处理。
wd.kindCashout: 商户提现（到已登记的钱包）
wd.noWallet: 还没有登记的钱包，请联系我们登记。
wd.cancelConfirm: 确定取消这笔提币？冻结的金额会退回可用余额。
wd.cancelled: 已取消，{amount} USDT 已解冻。
wd.errInsufficient: 余额不足：金额加手续费超过了可用余额。
wd.errAddress: 请输入正确的 TRON 地址（T 开头，34 位）。
wd.errAmount: 请输入大于 0 的金额，最多 6 位小数。
wd.submitted: 已提交，{amount} USDT 已冻结，处理完成前不能使用。
wd.customerHint: 代付给你的客户时填写，用于按客户统计。

api.title: API 设置
api.secretHidden: 只在生成时显示一次，之后无法再查看。
api.regenConfirm: 确定重新生成？旧的 Secret 会立即失效，请先准备好更新你的系统。
api.regenDone: 新的 Secret（请立即复制保存，之后不会再显示）：
api.callbackHint: 只支持 https。每一次回调都带签名；请返回 HTTP 2xx。失败时在 1 分钟、5 分钟、30 分钟、2 小时、6 小时、12 小时、24 小时后重试。
api.errCallback: 请输入 https:// 开头的地址。
api.ipHint: 每行一个 IPv4 或 IPv6 地址。只接受来自这些地址的 API 提币请求。
api.ipWarn: 没有设置 IP 白名单：你的账户不能用 API 提币。订单、地址和查询接口不受影响。
api.errIp: 第 {n} 行不是有效的 IP 地址。
api.testSent: 测试回调已发送，结果请看“回调记录”。
api.sandboxBody: 在测试环境使用单独的沙箱 Key（TRON Nile 测试网，只有测试币）。

pay.warn: 请只转 USDT-TRC20（TRON 网络），并按上面的金额转账。转入其他币或使用其他网络，资金将无法找回。
